jira.note: The command must be this launch script, not `uvx mcp-atlassian` directly — mcp-atlassian needs JIRA_URL/JIRA_USERNAME/JIRA_API_TOKEN, and this script is what reads them from the macOS Keychain (service 'mcp-atlassian', accounts JIRAEU_USERNAME/JIRAEU_API_TOKEN) and exports them before exec-ing uvx. Never put credentials in this file or in .env in git.
